subject: [PATCH v8 0/8] mm: Hot page tracking and promotion infrastructure

reviews.author: Joshua Hahn
reviews.summary: Raised concerns about making hot page tracking a tunable parameter, suggesting it may not be necessary for all workloads.

reviews.author: Bharata B Rao
reviews.summary: Clarified the design of hot page tracking, explaining that it considers both access frequency and recency, and defended the use of a tunable parameter.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: The patch introduces hot page tracking and promotion infrastructure, allowing for more efficient memory management.
